direction: Analysis sheets already reverse negative criteria; no second reversal.
predictorMatrix: Observed correlations from supplemental Table S7 at published two-decimal precision.
method: Solve C beta_j = r_j. Level_j = mean(beta_j) sum(z). Pattern_j = centered(beta_j) dot z. Combined_j = beta_j dot z. Average criterion scores with equal weight within each final cluster/family.
limits: Rounded predictor matrix and source precision make this an approximate reconstruction.
The equal-weight mean index is a defined app summary, not a separately fitted success scale.
No rescaling to the SD of a measured composite and no normative percentile conversion.
No external individual validation or calibrated success probabilities.
